## Safety checklist

- [ ] No unsupported capability or metric claim was added.
- [ ] Conflicting evidence and unavailable dependencies remain explicit.
- [ ] Mandatory detector failure cannot produce `GO`.
- [ ] No confidential, copyrighted-without-permission or biometric fixture was committed.
- [ ] Policy/model/threshold changes are versioned and tested.
- [ ] Documentation and threat-model implications were reviewed.
